Sam (AE): Heads-up — Auric signed a 30-day POC. Key asks: customer wants a quantized 13B variant with prefix/KV caching, strict KMS for keys, and the ability to fall back to a smaller model if latency spikes. Any immediate compatibility or pricing blockers?
Priya (SE): Do we have an "auric-13b-quant" variant in the catalog? If not, how big a lift to adapt an existing 13B?
Sam (AE): They listed throughput target ~40 req/sec @ p90 < 450ms for short prompts (<= 256 tokens). Will pay for dedicated if needed. Pricing question: how to quote burst vs base reserved for a month?
Lina (Solutions): Security: they need answers for our questionnaire Q3–Q7 about KMS and data residency. Will ask legal for the template but we should confirm Private deployment option and KMS integration.
Elliot (Infra): For p90 < 450ms at 40 rps, dedicated GPU pool likely. Quant helps but depends on kernel support for the model arch. Need model artifact to run quick compatibility. Also KV cache helps latency but increases memory per-session.
Priya (SE): Quick check: our catalog has "auric-13b-v1" (fp16) and "auric-7b-quant". No 13b-quant yet. If vendor provides HF-like weights we can test quantize -> run perf. Timeline ~2-3 business days for a basic perf/compat scan.
Sam (AE): Customer can provide weights or we vendor-host. They prefer we host. I'll ask for a sample model tarball this afternoon.
Lina (Solutions): I'll draft answers to KMS and data flow. One blocker: Auric requires SOC2 + an encryption attestation — flagging legal.
Priya (SE): Minimal config I'll try locally, sharing perf notes here. Patch I plan to run:
```yaml
model: auric-13b-quant-probe
quantize: true
kv_cache: enabled
max_seq: 512
device: gpu
```
Priya (SE): If quant path trips on rmsnorm/kernel mismatch we'll need a fallback build or use fp16 with dynamic batching.
Elliot (Infra): Also callout: KMS + Private (VPC) requires an onboarding runbook — provisioning VPN, KMS creds, and audit logs. That's a few days of infra work plus security review.
Sam (AE): Pricing note from me: propose reserved baseline 16x A100-hours equivalent + burst pool. Sales asks for a draft quote by EOD Fri.
Lina (Solutions): I'm pinging legal about attestation and will attach our standard MSA addendum.
deploy-bot: Ticket created: POC-431987 — "Auric 13B quant POC" assigned to Priya, Elliot. ETA probe job queued. :gear:
Priya (SE): Starting compatibility probe now. Will post logs and a short perf summary.
Priya (SE): Quick log snippet: 
```
loading weights... OK
quantizing (#bits=8) ... partial kernel fallback at layer 24
inference warmup: 1.2ms/token
batch 8 throughput ~48 rps (short prompts)
```
Elliot (Infra): Interesting — partial kernel fallback suggests we should test a fallback model path to avoid p90 spikes. I'll sketch routing policy: prefer quantized variant, fallback to fp16 auric-13b-v1, then auric-7b for degraded latency.
Sam (AE): Good. Customer wants canary rollout too. Can we do canary with traffic split 10/90?
Priya (SE): Yes — runtime supports per-route split. I'll attach a minimal rollout config after probe.
Lina (Solutions): Next steps: 1) Priya — finish perf scan + upload results; 2) Elliot — prepare infra runbook & cost estimate for dedicated + burst; 3) Sam — collect model artifact & security questionnaire responses from customer; 4) Lina — coordinate legal.
Sam (AE): Thx. Scheduling a sync Thurs 10am PT with Auric + SE + Infra + Legal. 
Priya (SE): Will have probe findings and a first-cut rollout config by then.
Elliot (Infra): Noted — I'll produce rough cost delta for quant vs fp16 and expected GPU footprint.
Lina (Solutions): I'll draft the KMS section and list remaining security docs.
Sam (AE): Great — moving to the POC channel after this thread. :rocket:
